responsibility: This header defines the gcc_target structure and associated target-facing types that the middle end and backend use to query machine-specific behavior. It introduces shared enums and helper structs such as by_pieces_operation, secondary_reload_info, asm_int_op, vectorizer cost enums, and cumulative_args_t packing helpers, then expands target.def into the concrete nested hook structure and declares the global targetm instance that each backend populates with its hook implementations and defaulted entries.
same_name_distinction: Provides the concrete target-facing types and the expanded struct gcc_target interface by including gcc/target.def, whereas gcc/target.def is the declarative hook specification source rather than a normal header with finalized structure layout.
